look: THE BLACK BOX: Ultra-minimalist futuristic industrial design, precision watchmaking, advanced semiconductor engineering, and mysterious science-fiction technology. An Apple-level luxury product reveal, a science-fiction title sequence and a high-budget mechanical engineering visualization: a black titanium monolith in darkness opens into an exploded view of glass, circuit boards, counter-rotating rings and a glowing octagonal core, then reassembles; hairline engineering annotations; exceptional contrast and negative space.

scenes.name: Unknown object
scenes.desc: A thin light sweep finds a black monolith floating in darkness; a seam pulses once; dormant labels appear.

scenes.name: First separation
scenes.desc: Cyan escapes the seam; shell, glass cover, plates and boards separate into an aligned exploded stack.

scenes.name: Into the machine
scenes.desc: The camera pushes through the layers as traces light up and stabilization rings counter-rotate.

scenes.name: Core awakens
scenes.desc: The octagonal core ignites, rings accelerate, and a pulse at 17 seconds freezes everything.

scenes.name: Reassembly
scenes.desc: Every component returns along its path; panels lock; a ring pulse runs the outer seam.

scenes.name: Identity reveal
scenes.desc: A line traces the silhouette and becomes the OBSIDIAN X-01 title beside the still monolith.
